title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Organism Type

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'General determination: Typing — type of an organism (serotype, genotype, biotype)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Property = Type with an organism in 'Inheres in': serotyping, HBV/HCV genotype, biotype of an isolate. Sits between determination and susceptibility in the 2027 module (no own profile). Parts: LOINC enumeration (21, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (1), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 410656007 |Type (property) (qualifier value)|, 704319004 |Inheres in (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)|`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
